settings.heading: Consult
settings.text: We get to know your event, your guests, and the experience you want to create.

settings.heading: Curate
settings.text: We design a custom menu of monograms, icons, thread colors, and products that fits your event.

settings.heading: Stitch
settings.text: We arrive on-site and personalize each piece live, creating a memorable guest experience.

settings.heading: Three-hour minimum
settings.text: Events begin with a three-hour booking so guests have time to enjoy the full experience.

settings.heading: Approximately 10 items/hour
settings.text: Capacity depends on design complexity, placement, products, and personalization choices.

settings.heading: Fully curated
settings.text: Product, design, and thread options are planned in advance to complement your event.

settings.heading: Private or corporate
settings.text: Perfect for celebrations, gifting suites, launches, brand activations, and community events.
